title: Support agent: resolving tickets
brief: You own the Datacore support agent built on the Agent SDK. It handles high-ambiguity tickets: refunds, disputed charges, account access problems. It reaches the backend through in-house MCP tools — get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund and escalate_to_human. The goal is resolving more than 80% of tickets on first contact while recognising in time when a human is needed.

title: Development with Claude Code
brief: The Datacore engineering team uses Claude Code for code generation, refactoring, debugging and documentation across a twelve-package monorepo. It has to fit the team workflow: conventions in CLAUDE.md, custom slash commands and skills, and a sensible choice between planning and direct execution.

title: Multi-agent research system
brief: You are building a market research system on the Agent SDK. A coordinator delegates to specialised subagents: one searches the web, one analyses internal documents, one synthesises findings, one produces the report. The output is properly attributed reviews that go to the leadership team.

title: Developer productivity tooling
brief: You are building an internal Agent SDK tool that helps engineers explore unfamiliar code, understand legacy systems, generate boilerplate and automate routine work. It relies on the built-in tools (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob) and connected MCP servers.

title: Claude Code in the CI pipeline
brief: Claude Code is wired into the Datacore build pipeline: automated pull request review, test generation, inline comments. The prompts must produce actionable feedback and keep false positives down — otherwise developers stop reading the comments.

title: Structured data extraction
brief: The system extracts data from supplier documents — invoices, delivery notes, specifications — in twenty different formats, validates it against JSON schemas and feeds the ERP. Accuracy is critical: an error goes straight to accounting, and edge cases must be handled predictably.
